messages.subject: A warning message: standard errors and cov.lv
parts:
Dear lavaan users,
 
I got this warning message as following:
Error in solve.default(E) : 
  system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number = 3.23042e-19
Warning messages:
1: In estimateVCOV(lavaanModel, samplestats = lavaanSampleStats, options = lavaanOptions,  :
  lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!

2: In lavaan(model1, data = nomissing, auto.var = TRUE, auto.fix.first = TRUE,  :
  lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite;in group2. use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.
 
 
I did inspect as following:
 
> inspect(fit1, "cov.lv")


$`1`

EASYOFUSE      23.328

$`0`

What should I fix?
 
Thanks for your advice
Best Regards,

messages.subject: Re: A warning message: standard errors and cov.lv
parts:
On 01/07/2013 09:30 PM, Yonghwan Chang wrote:
> Dear lavaan users,
> I got this warning message as following:
>
> Error in solve.default(E) :
> system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number = 3.23042e-19
> Warning messages:
> 1: In estimateVCOV(lavaanModel, samplestats = lavaanSampleStats, options = lavaanOptions, :
> lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!

This is most often a symptom of a non-identifiable model. Or a very bad
fitting one. Without seeing your model syntax, it is hard to judge.

> 2: In lavaan(model1, data = nomissing, auto.var = TRUE, auto.fix.first = TRUE, :
> lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite;in group2. use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.

Perhaps adding more constraints: did you constrain the intercepts and
factor loadings to be equal across groups?

Yves.
